name: bidex-camera-v4
description: Finite collision-aware camera-local extrinsic perturbations with an exact 2:1:1:1 nominal/head-only/wrists-only/head-and-wrists occurrence schedule. Head cameras use at most 1.8 cm / 6 degrees; wrist cameras use at most 1.35 cm / 6 degrees and may only translate outward along their mount-clearance axis.

left_wrist.reason: The Franka wrist camera is mounted at positive link-Z; allowing only outward Z motion prevents the link8 connector entering the view.

right_wrist.reason: The Franka wrist camera is mounted at positive link-Z; allowing only outward Z motion prevents the link8 connector entering the view.

head.reason: The Astribot head camera may move outward but not inward through the head shell.

left_wrist.reason: The left wrist camera is mounted at negative tool-X; only outward X motion keeps the tool connector behind the camera.

right_wrist.reason: The right wrist camera is mounted at positive tool-X; only outward X motion keeps the tool connector behind the camera.
